verdict.rationale: The pack documents no user-configurable scheduler for recurring jobs or workflows. The nearest items are adjacent behaviors: access-review reminders tied to policy timelines, and monitors and integrations that refresh 'up to daily or ad-hoc' on a vendor-controlled cadence. Neither lets the user define or schedule their own recurring job, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
